_doc: Firmament Ages - Creeping Darkness (S1f, Felix 2026-10-18): the night grows worse with every Age, the day stays as it is.
One row per Age (the world's Age, AgeService snapshot). firmages-core hardship/NightsService reads it (the build copies it into
the jar, this datapack copy wins): a hostile mob that spawns naturally in the dark (night under the open sky, or no sky light at
all: caves, the Nether) gets health and damage x the row, and the 'gear' armour and sword with 'gear_chance' per piece
(entity tags firmages:blood_moon_armored / blood_moon_melee, only empty slots). 'night_spawn' > 1: each natural dark spawn
brings a second mob of its kind with chance night_spawn - 1. Bosses (c:bosses), the Cave Dweller, spawners, eggs and
commands are never touched; passive mobs and pets are no monsters. kubejs/server_scripts/firmages/blood_moon.js keeps the
share 'blood_moon_keep' of the blood moons Enhanced Celestials 2 rolls (0 = none; mob_2 gate stays) and turns super blood
moons into plain ones while 'super_blood_moon' is false. CaveDwellerService lets a timed Cave Dweller spawn with chance
'cave_dweller_hunt' (0 from hardship.caveDwellerUntilAge on, H12). kubejs/server_scripts/stages/grants.js sets the Apotheosis
world tier 'apoth_tier' on every Age grant and login (/apoth set_world_tier <player> <tier>, Apotheosis 8.9.0 javap).
More Darkness is client-only with one static config, so the darkness itself does not change per Age.
Gear: a TFC metal (tfc:metal/<helmet|chestplate|greaves|boots|sword>/<metal>) one Age behind the players, or the vanilla
diamond / netherite set late. Checked by dev/gen_nights.py --check, NightsTableTest and /firmages selftest nights.

ages.why: Bare hands and flint: vanilla nights are already deadly; the Cave Dweller hunts at half rate in the deep caves.
Stone tools and first copper: a little tougher, no gear yet, the player has no metal armour either.
Bronze armour on the player (ore ladder 1): rare copper pieces on mobs, one Age behind.
Wrought iron and steel for the player: bronze mobs, first blood moons (mob_2); the Cave Dweller is gone (H12).
Steel armour plus arcane wards: wrought iron mobs; Apotheosis opens here, Frontier tier.
Black steel for the player (ore ladder 2.5): steel mobs, blood moons more often.
Red steel and powered tools: black steel mobs; super blood moons join the sky.
Blue steel and Mekanism armour start: red steel mobs.
MekaSuit and Draconic wyvern gear: blue steel mobs, nights twice as tough as Dawn.
Draconic armour with shields: diamond mobs, every blood moon Enhanced Celestials rolls.
Chaotic armour: netherite mobs, double spawns, Pinnacle tier; the darkest nights of the pack.
